name: Net2Net-Local-RADIUS-Manager
description: Local, per-WISP MikroTik PPPoE RADIUS manager. Stores data inside the mapped appdata folder. Exposes the web portal on 8080 and RADIUS authentication/accounting on UDP 1812/1813.

paths.name: Application data
paths.description: Persistent database, branding, and backups. Include this folder in Unraid backups.

variables.name: Application secret
variables.description: A unique random value, at least 32 characters. Never reuse it between WISPs.

variables.name: Initial Super Admin password
variables.description: Used only on the first start, when the database is empty.

variables.name: Initial WISP Admin password
variables.description: Used only on the first start, when the database is empty.

variables.name: RADIUS shared secret
variables.description: Must match every MikroTik /radius secret. Use a unique long value per WISP.

variables.name: UISP / UNMS server URL
variables.description: Optional UISP server address, for example https://uisp.example.net.

variables.name: UISP / UNMS API token
variables.description: Optional UISP API token for CRM synchronisation. Leave blank when UISP is not used.

variables.name: Private RADIUS client network
variables.description: Optional private CIDR allowed to source RADIUS requests, for example 10.10.0.0/16. Leave blank to permit only registered router addresses.
